text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day during summer camp, just after
we finish
training...

text_block_list.name: Student A
text_block_list.text: Wow, was Gold City gorgeous or what?

text_block_list.name: Student B
text_block_list.text: She sure was! She was in her tracksuit, but she looked breathtaking just standing there, staring at the ocean. No wonder she's a model!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Sounds like City is by herself.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Gimme some courage, please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I really look up t'City, but I still get real
flustered
chatt'n with her.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But even if it means I'll be overstepp'n, I
still
wanna go talk t'her. So gimme some
strength!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: One more time, please!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks bunches! I'm going for it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um, City?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: ...Oh wow.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Your hair looks beautiful all lit up by the
sett'n
sun.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Please... just don't.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You know, you're really amazing,
Yukino.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
You must have realized by now that
sometimes
life doesn't go the way you
want.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
I used to think everything came down to
talent. I
thought people's hearts, the
way they looked at

me—everything—would change if I just
kept
running...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But that wasn't the case. I was the only
one who
wanted anything to change.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Turns out... all that running was
pointless. My
image—my life—I can't
change a thing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
But you know all that, don't you? And
somehow,
you still face the world head
held high. It's
amazing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: I mean that. I could never—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Stop it!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Wh-what?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I don't wanna hear that kinda talk from
you!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're the one who's amaz'n, City!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're the city girl I've always, alwaaays looked up to!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I... I never really knew what kinda person
I wanted
to be. I was just runn'n 'cause
that's what I was
good at.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But then I read that interview of yours in
that
magazine.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
You were so bright and dazzl'n! I didn't
know
there were Umamusume like you
out there, but
once I did, I wanted t'be
just like you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You were my first dream.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I mean, I prob'ly still would've moved to
Tokyo
and started runn'n even if I didn't
know about
you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And sure, I would've worked hard, but
I'd've been
plenty happy with whatever
results I got in
whatever races I ran.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: 'Cause I know that without a dream, I never would've stuck it out and done the best I could.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Eventually, I'd return home t'streamers
and
fanfare, and ev'ryone'd tell me how
good I did.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And then I'd live out my happy li'l life in
my
hometown.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
A happily ever after... surrounded by
people I
love.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But you know, I think I'm just as happy
now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I fin'lly have a dream. I've found a place
I want
t'stay, no matter how tough the
going gets.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I actually... believe in m'self now.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And it's all thanks t'you, City. You're the
one who
called out t'me and pulled me
into this world full
of glitz and glam.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I dunno what it is that's troubl'n you, but
when I
look at you, I see the coolest and
most amaz'n
Umamusume ever!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Um, sorry... I'm prob'ly not mak'n much
sense.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Anyway... What I'm try'n to say is... uh...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I wanna run with you.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yukino...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's a real challenge try'n to become the
best
version of yourself, and it's just as
hard gett'n
people to like that same
version of you.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
But don't y'think you'd hate it even more
if you
stopped runn'n?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Especially now that y'know what kinda
person you
wanna become.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I know believ'n in yourself is hard, so
let's... just
take it one step at a time,
'kay?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure that one day, we'll come t'love
who we've
become.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: You really are amazing.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry you had to see me like this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I didn't see noth'n to be ashamed of.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even when you're struggl'n, you're still
cool as
ever, City.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You'll always be the cat's pajamas.
